probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue structures__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain __that is not disclosed in Shahbabian or Cowan et al__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a specific surgical function not disclosed in the prior art__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered in a manner distinct from the methods disclosed in Cowan et al and Putz__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __such that the device creates a path that extends beyond the cranial opening into deeper brain tissue__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __in a configuration that differs from the Shahbabian and Cowan et al disclosures__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining hemostasis at the site__.

7. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue structures__; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __that is not disclosed in Cowan et al__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a specific surgical function not disclosed in the prior art__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the working channel in a manner distinct from the methods disclosed in Cowan et al and Putz__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __in a configuration that differs from the Cowan et al disclosure__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while maintaining hemostasis at the site__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __in conjunction with the radial contraction and removal steps__.

13. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue structures__; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __that is not disclosed in Poole et al__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured to perform a specific surgical function not disclosed in the prior art__.

15. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __in a configuration that differs from the Poole et al disclosure__.

17. (Original) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
